[Amulet of the Hellcat](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3224)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 106

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This glass amulet is set on a steel backing shaped like a cage and flickers with an eerie crimson glow. Magically sealed within is a portion of a hellcat's ever-burning heart. While wearing the amulet, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks made while in [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407), and you can cast the [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1585) cantrip emanating from the amulet as an [innate](/Rules.aspx?ID=2232) divine spell.

**Activate—Invisible Pounce** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are in bright light; **Effect** You become [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=83), [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305) up to your speed, and then make a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) at the end of that movement. After making the Strike, you are no longer invisible. If at any point during your Stride, you pass out of [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402), you are no longer invisible and must stop moving. You may make a melee Strike if you have a target within reach.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the heart of a [hellcat](/Monsters.aspx?ID=695).

</column>

>
[Ancestral Geometry](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2202)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Geometric precision and perfect angles signify that an artist with exemplary knowledge of [dwarven](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=1) tattooing traditions created this body art. Your family's ancestral stories, recited throughout the tattooing process, bind your blood even tighter to theirs. During your daily preparations, you manifest a visitation by an ancestor—possibly via a dream, a vision, or a magical trinket left by your bedroll. Roll 2d20 and record the highest result. Then roll 1d6 and note a type of saving throw: 1–2 Fortitude, 3–4 Reflex, and 5–6 Will.

 In addition, until the next visitation, you gain a +1 item bonus to one [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill related to the ancestor, as determined by the GM. Usually, the ancestor provides a kind of knowledge they believe you'll need. For dwarven ancestors, the Lore skill is usually Architecture Lore, Engineering Lore, Genealogy Lore, Labor Lore, Mining Lore, Warfare Lore, or Lore about a dwarven deity.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=612)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You rolled a saving throw of the noted type;  **Effect** Replace the roll with the d20 roll from your ancestor's visitation.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

Animal calls are often whistles or similar devices that imitate the calls of [animals](/Traits.aspx?ID=531). Each call is for a specific type of animal, such as a duck or bear. When you use the call, it gives you a +1 item bonus to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=2400), provided the animal is of the type as the call. You also do not take a circumstance penalty when attempting to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395) that animal for not sharing a language.

---

The strings of this spider-shaped lute are made from the webbing of a [goliath spider](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3209) and the tuning pegs are crafted from the spider’s spinnerets. An _arachnolute_ grants you a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument.

**Activate—Web Chord** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Sticky webbing sprays in a 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386) as you strum the lute’s strings. Each creature in the area of the webbing is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81) unless it succeeds at a DC 29 Reflex save.

**Craft Requirements** The initial materials must include the spinnerets of a [goliath spider](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3209), as well as a spool of its webbing.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Archivist's Gaze](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1038)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 179

**Price** 24,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This strange contraption slides over your eyes, supernaturally sharpening your mind. While peering through it, you can feel some entity whispering to you, telling all sorts of things about the subject of your gaze. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) (though some entities might grant a bonus to a different skill, as determined by your GM). In addition, when you employ an exploration tactic other than Investigating, you also gain the benefits of [Investigating](/Actions.aspx?ID=516) unless you choose not to.

 When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you the higher score. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence score. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _archivist's gaze_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Pushing the glasses up your nose and asking the entity for help, you cause the spectacles to cast either [_true seeing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) or a 3rd-level [_comprehend language_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) on you. Because the entity tied to the spectacles chooses which one, the GM picks whichever spell is most immediately useful in your current situation (and chooses the most useful language each time the item casts _comprehend language_). The spell lasts for 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

This oily mix of herbs and natural detergents can be applied to a creature to reduce and cover any ordinary odors they produce. The creature receives a +2 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) against creatures using primarily smell. This bonus also applies to the DC to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=2408) the creature by scent. The listed amount is enough to cover one Medium or smaller creature and takes 1 minute to apply. The effect lasts for 1 hour after applying.

    level="1"
    right="Item 2"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Aromatic Ammunition](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1188)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 168

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">
**Ammunition** any

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The components of this ammunition emit a strong smell when combined during its activation. A creature hit by an activated aromatic ammunition gains a distinct odor for up to 1 hour or until the scent is washed off (requiring at least a gallon of water and 10 minutes of scrubbing). Any creatures within 30 feet smell the target, allowing even those with a weak sense of smell to detect its presence, and all creatures gain a +1 item bonus to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) the affected creature for as long as it has the odor. A creature that has imprecise or precise [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) doubles the range at which they can detect the target using their scent compared to the normal range of their scent.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Artificer Spectacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2134)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These seemingly ordinary rectangular eyeglasses feature clear lenses framed in copper. When invested and worn, they rest perfectly on the bridge of the nose and can only be removed by the wearer. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks and any skill check made to [Identify Magic](/Actions.aspx?ID=24). When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. You must select the skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _artificer spectacles_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 3rd-rank [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell on an item you touch.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Ash Gown](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2599)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 122

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn clothing

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Ash gowns_ are formal wear spun from smoke, ash, and char collected from the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6). Typically, they're voluminous floor-length dresses or three-piece suits, but regardless of their specific tailoring, _ash gowns_ are always an ostentatious display of wealth and loyalty to the powers of the Plane of Fire. They're exceptionally popular in the courts of the [Elemental Lords](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8) and among the high society of Medina Mudii'a. The gown grants you resistance 5 to fire and a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks.

**Activate—Blazing Promenade** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The ash gown ignites in a ferocious blaze, flames licking the floor and trailing behind you like a dancing cape. You Stride and make a Strike at the end of your movement. During the Stride, your flames incinerate minor obstacles in your path; you ignore non-magical [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453), and any you move through is destroyed. Creatures that are adjacent to you at any point during your movement take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. A creature doesn't need to attempt this save more than once, even if you move past it multiple times.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>

</title>

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Ash Gown (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 122

**Price** 1,300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

The resistance to fire is 10, and the bonus to Intimidation checks is +2. You can activate a _greater ash gown_ once per 10 minutes instead of once per day. The activation's damage increases to 4d6, and its DC increases to 28.

---

_Ash gowns_ are formal wear spun from smoke, ash, and char collected from the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6). Typically, they're voluminous floor-length dresses or three-piece suits, but regardless of their specific tailoring, _ash gowns_ are always an ostentatious display of wealth and loyalty to the powers of the Plane of Fire. They're exceptionally popular in the courts of the [Elemental Lords](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8) and among the high society of Medina Mudii'a. The gown grants you resistance 5 to fire and a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks.

**Activate—Blazing Promenade** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The ash gown ignites in a ferocious blaze, flames licking the floor and trailing behind you like a dancing cape. You Stride and make a Strike at the end of your movement. During the Stride, your flames incinerate minor obstacles in your path; you ignore non-magical [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453), and any you move through is destroyed. Creatures that are adjacent to you at any point during your movement take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. A creature doesn't need to attempt this save more than once, even if you move past it multiple times.

---

These paired bracers of red leather appear as plain armbands on the outside but display the branded symbol of [Achaekek](/Deities.aspx?ID=325) on the inside. They grant the wearer a +1 item bonus to AC and saving throws, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5 as armor. You can affix talismans to _assassin's bracers_ as though they were light armor.

**Activate—Focus on the Doomed** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You designate one creature within 30 feet. You cast 4th-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577) on yourself, but the designated creature can still see you. The bracers enhance your appearance to the designated creature, making you appear more fearsome and unnerving, granting you a +1 item bonus to attempts to Feint or Demoralize the designated creature. The designated creature takes a –1 item penalty to saving throws against fear effects.

The _atlas arcane_ always shows the surrounding area (out to a 36- mile radius centered on the map) with a reasonable level of detail, providing a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks and any skill checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Rules.aspx?ID=2638), provided the checks are related to the location detailed on the map.

**Activate—Situation Report** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [detection](/Traits.aspx?ID=574), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You speak a command phrase, and the map reveals the location of all troop movements within the area it maps. This intel is current the moment the phrase is spoken but does not update afterward, and moving the map does not reveal further intel.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Avalanche Boots](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2135)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While the insides of these boots are comfortable, fur-lined leather, the outsides are a jumble of slate plates, giving the impression of a rockslide. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34) and [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38). When you invest the boots, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You succeed or critically succeed with a Shove;  **Effect** If the Shove was a success, you push your opponent up to 10 feet instead of 5 feet. If the Shove was a critical success, you push your opponent up to 20 feet, and you can then choose to knock them [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 26"
    pfs=""
>
[Axe of the Dwarven Lords](/Equipment.aspx?ID=609)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Gamemastery Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=22) pg. 106

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 3
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Dwarven War Axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=62)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The blade of this _+4 major striking [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=300) [returning](/Equipment.aspx?ID=301) [speed](/Equipment.aspx?ID=304) [dwarven waraxe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=62)_ is carved with an intricate design depicting countless generations of great dwarven warriors and leaders. The axe has the [thrown 30 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=195) weapon trait, in addition to the normal weapon traits for a dwarven waraxe. Strikes with the axe deal an additional 1d6 damage to orcs. While the axe is in your possession, you gain a +4 item bonus when [Crafting](/Actions.aspx?ID=43) armor, jewelry, metalworking, stonemasonry, snares, traps, and weapons. If you are a [dwarf](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=1), you gain [greater darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) while holding the axe. If you are not a dwarf, you are [stupefied 4](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) while holding the axe, and if you are an orc, you are also [drained 4](/Conditions.aspx?ID=10) and [enfeebled 4](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) while holding it.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** The axe casts a 10th-level [_summon elemental_](/Spells.aspx?ID=320) spell to conjure an [elite elemental avalanche](/Monsters.aspx?ID=186). The spell is automatically sustained, requiring no action on your part but still allowing you to command the elemental on each of your turns. You can Dismiss the Spell.

**Destruction** If an orc beheads a dwarven king with the _Axe of the Dwarven Lords_, the axe rusts away to nothing.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 26 Axe of the Dwarven Lords Unique Artifact Conjuration Magical Transmutation Source Gamemastery Guide pg. 106 Usage held in 2 hands Bulk 3 Base Weapon Dwarven War Axe The blade of this +4 major striking keen returning speed dwarven waraxe is carved with an intricate design depicting countless generations of great dwarven warriors and leaders. The axe has the thrown 30 feet weapon trait, in addition to the normal weapon traits for a dwarven waraxe. Strikes with the axe deal an additional 1d6 damage to orcs. While the axe is in your possession, you gain a +4 item bonus when Crafting armor, jewelry, metalworking, stonemasonry, snares, traps, and weapons. If you are a dwarf, you gain greater darkvision while holding the axe. If you are not a dwarf, you are stupefied 4 while holding the axe, and if you are an orc, you are also drained 4 and enfeebled 4 while holding it. Activate Three Actions envision, Interact; Frequency once per week; Effect The axe casts a 10th-level summon elemental spell to conjure an elite elemental avalanche. The spell is automatically sustained, requiring no action on your part but still allowing you to command the elemental on each of your turns. You can Dismiss the Spell. Destruction If an orc beheads a dwarven king with the Axe of the Dwarven Lords , the axe rusts away to nothing.

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

**_Nethys Note: This entry contains spoilers for The Dead God's Hand. Read at your own risk._**

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is among the most famous creations of the swordsmith (and eventual living god) [Aroden](/Deities.aspx?ID=512). Initially forged to serve as a badge of office for the next emperor of Azlant, this plan fell apart when King Xeros failed to choose his successor from a field of fools and criminals. When he asked Aroden for aid in choosing, the Last Azlanti chose to keep the _Azlanti Diamond_ for himself. Whether not this choice provoked the veiled masters into destroying Azlant with Earthfall or was the result of that doom forcing Aroden's hand has been lost to time—but PCs who take the Test of Aroden in this adventure have a good indication that it was a little bit of both! Following Earthfall, the Azlanti Diamond served Aroden for centuries. Now and then, he loaned the sword out to those he deemed worthy. Each time, the sword's power reset and then grew alongside its new carrier, eventually returning to Aroden's hand to begin the cycle anew. Some time after Aroden became a god and founded the city of Absalom, he bequeathed the sword to the caretakers of the Sanctum of Aroden, and for the past several thousand years it has remained therein.

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=386)_. Its clear crystal blade is made of diamond, hardened to a strength equal to [highgrade throneglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5212) (although without the other qualities of high-grade throneglass). When first claimed by a character, it bonds with that character's soul, and as time passes the weapon's fundamental runes automatically grow in power, becoming a _+2 greater striking longsword_ after 1 year and finally a _+3 major striking longsword_ after it has been carried and wielded by the same person for 2 years. If the sword falls out of that character's possession it stops increasing in power until it is reclaimed, at which point the count begins where it left off. At your discretion, a PC can upgrade the weapon's fundamental runes normally, or they could even automatically progress not as time passes but as its wielder's level rises to match the corresponding fundamental runes.

As long as the _Azlanti Diamond_ is carried, its wielder can speak and understand ancient [Azlanti](/Languages.aspx?ID=49), and they gain a +1 item bonus to [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37), and [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. These item bonuses increase to +2 once the wielder is 9th level, then increase again to +3 once the wielder is 17th level.

Unlike the standard rules for a [specific weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=3179), the _Azlanti Diamond_ can be etched with weapon property runes. Etching a weapon property rune onto the _Azlanti Diamond_ is free—it never costs money to etch a rune onto this artifact.

---

**Minor Gifts:** [divine retribution](/Relics.aspx?ID=136), [recalculate](/Relics.aspx?ID=173) 

**Major Gifts:** [psychic scream](/Relics.aspx?ID=176), [sacred glow](/Relics.aspx?ID=140) 

**Grand Gift:** [mental bastion](/Relics.aspx?ID=177) 

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is never less than an 8th-level item, and as its wielder gains levels, it gains levels to match—a wielder who is higher than 8th level causes the _Azlanti Diamond_ to automatically rise in level to match. This means it always has its two minor gifts active. It gains its first major gift at 9th level, and its second at 13th level, then gains its grand gift at 17th level. These gifts are gained automatically, without the need to achieve any additional requirement.

**Destruction** The _Azlanti Diamond_ is destroyed if it is used in an attempt to shatter the _Starstone_ by a [human](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=64) who wasn't born as a human and has never heard of Aroden.

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is among the most famous creations of the swordsmith (and eventual living god) [Aroden](/Deities.aspx?ID=512). Initially forged to serve as a badge of office for the next emperor of Azlant, this plan fell apart when King Xeros failed to choose his successor from a field of fools and criminals. When he asked Aroden for aid in choosing, the Last Azlanti chose to keep the _Azlanti Diamond_ for himself. Whether not this choice provoked the veiled masters into destroying Azlant with Earthfall or was the result of that doom forcing Aroden's hand has been lost to time—but PCs who take the Test of Aroden in this adventure have a good indication that it was a little bit of both! Following Earthfall, the Azlanti Diamond served Aroden for centuries. Now and then, he loaned the sword out to those he deemed worthy. Each time, the sword's power reset and then grew alongside its new carrier, eventually returning to Aroden's hand to begin the cycle anew. Some time after Aroden became a god and founded the city of Absalom, he bequeathed the sword to the caretakers of the Sanctum of Aroden, and for the past several thousand years it has remained therein.

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=386)_. Its clear crystal blade is made of diamond, hardened to a strength equal to [highgrade throneglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5212) (although without the other qualities of high-grade throneglass). When first claimed by a character, it bonds with that character's soul, and as time passes the weapon's fundamental runes automatically grow in power, becoming a _+2 greater striking longsword_ after 1 year and finally a _+3 major striking longsword_ after it has been carried and wielded by the same person for 2 years. If the sword falls out of that character's possession it stops increasing in power until it is reclaimed, at which point the count begins where it left off. At your discretion, a PC can upgrade the weapon's fundamental runes normally, or they could even automatically progress not as time passes but as its wielder's level rises to match the corresponding fundamental runes.

As long as the _Azlanti Diamond_ is carried, its wielder can speak and understand ancient [Azlanti](/Languages.aspx?ID=49), and they gain a +1 item bonus to [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37), and [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. These item bonuses increase to +2 once the wielder is 9th level, then increase again to +3 once the wielder is 17th level.

Unlike the standard rules for a [specific weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=3179), the _Azlanti Diamond_ can be etched with weapon property runes. Etching a weapon property rune onto the _Azlanti Diamond_ is free—it never costs money to etch a rune onto this artifact.

**_Nethys Note: This entry contains spoilers for The Dead God's Hand. Read at your own risk._**

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is among the most famous creations of the swordsmith (and eventual living god) [Aroden](/Deities.aspx?ID=512). Initially forged to serve as a badge of office for the next emperor of Azlant, this plan fell apart when King Xeros failed to choose his successor from a field of fools and criminals. When he asked Aroden for aid in choosing, the Last Azlanti chose to keep the _Azlanti Diamond_ for himself. Whether not this choice provoked the veiled masters into destroying Azlant with Earthfall or was the result of that doom forcing Aroden's hand has been lost to time—but PCs who take the Test of Aroden in this adventure have a good indication that it was a little bit of both! Following Earthfall, the Azlanti Diamond served Aroden for centuries. Now and then, he loaned the sword out to those he deemed worthy. Each time, the sword's power reset and then grew alongside its new carrier, eventually returning to Aroden's hand to begin the cycle anew. Some time after Aroden became a god and founded the city of Absalom, he bequeathed the sword to the caretakers of the Sanctum of Aroden, and for the past several thousand years it has remained therein.

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [longsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=386)_. Its clear crystal blade is made of diamond, hardened to a strength equal to [highgrade throneglass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5212) (although without the other qualities of high-grade throneglass). When first claimed by a character, it bonds with that character's soul, and as time passes the weapon's fundamental runes automatically grow in power, becoming a _+2 greater striking longsword_ after 1 year and finally a _+3 major striking longsword_ after it has been carried and wielded by the same person for 2 years. If the sword falls out of that character's possession it stops increasing in power until it is reclaimed, at which point the count begins where it left off. At your discretion, a PC can upgrade the weapon's fundamental runes normally, or they could even automatically progress not as time passes but as its wielder's level rises to match the corresponding fundamental runes.

As long as the _Azlanti Diamond_ is carried, its wielder can speak and understand ancient [Azlanti](/Languages.aspx?ID=49), and they gain a +1 item bonus to [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37), and [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. These item bonuses increase to +2 once the wielder is 9th level, then increase again to +3 once the wielder is 17th level.

Unlike the standard rules for a [specific weapon](/Rules.aspx?ID=3179), the _Azlanti Diamond_ can be etched with weapon property runes. Etching a weapon property rune onto the _Azlanti Diamond_ is free—it never costs money to etch a rune onto this artifact.

---

**Minor Gifts:** [divine retribution](/Relics.aspx?ID=136), [recalculate](/Relics.aspx?ID=173) 

**Major Gifts:** [psychic scream](/Relics.aspx?ID=176), [sacred glow](/Relics.aspx?ID=140) 

**Grand Gift:** [mental bastion](/Relics.aspx?ID=177) 

The _Azlanti Diamond_ is never less than an 8th-level item, and as its wielder gains levels, it gains levels to match—a wielder who is higher than 8th level causes the _Azlanti Diamond_ to automatically rise in level to match. This means it always has its two minor gifts active. It gains its first major gift at 9th level, and its second at 13th level, then gains its grand gift at 17th level. These gifts are gained automatically, without the need to achieve any additional requirement.

**Destruction** The _Azlanti Diamond_ is destroyed if it is used in an attempt to shatter the _Starstone_ by a [human](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=64) who wasn't born as a human and has never heard of Aroden.

This pair of silver bangles is engraved with images of crowns. While wearing the bangles, you are filled with an overwhelming sense of assertiveness and a more commanding presence. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks. When you invest the bangles, you either increase your Charisma score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever is higher.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 3rd-level [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110) spell (DC 38).

You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to checks against the triggering creature for 1 round. You also gain 15 temporary Hit Points. You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

>
[Bargainer's Instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2116)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 96

**Price** 1,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>1 hour ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _bargainer’s instrument_ is a musical implement. The most typical version is a violin made from maple and spruce, its body stained so deep a purple it appears almost black. When activated, the instrument casts a [_binding circle_](/Rituals.aspx?ID=110) ritual to conjure a willing extraplanar talent to compete with you in performance.

The contest could be a musical battle, a dance-off, an oratorical debate—the two of you could even use entirely different types of performance. The loser of the bout is magically bound to perform a task of the winner’s choice within 1 week. The contest consists of taking turns to [Perform](/Actions.aspx?ID=2401), starting with your opponent. The Performance check’s DC is the higher of the opponent’s [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) DC or Will DC, though the two parties can mutually agree to use an impartial judge instead. The first to reach four successes wins, with each critical successes counting as two successes. If you play the bargainer’s instrument as part of your performance, it grants you a +2 item bonus to the Performance checks.

After the contest, the conjured creature can choose to return to where it came from or remain where you conjured it. The loser must endeavor to complete the task by all reasonable means within 1 week. Failing to complete it is shameful but has no further consequences. The instrument loses its magic and remains a non-magical [virtuoso instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Worn by [Iomedae's](/Deities.aspx?ID=9) prestigious knights, this _+2 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [bastion plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=17)_ is emblazoned with the Inheritor's [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) and sports a white cloak. As long as the cloak is red, you gain the benefits of the armor's deflect melee trait without needing to spend an additional action to activate it during each turn.

**Craft Requirements** You worship Iomedae.

---

Your limbs become extremely limber, letting you stretch and twist to extreme degrees at the cost of fine motor skills. 

**Benefit** You gain the listed item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), [Squeeze](/Actions.aspx?ID=31), and [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=29), and you increase your reach by the listed amount. 

**Drawback** You take a –1 penalty to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) checks, and attack rolls, and a –1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack damage.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Benthic Drums](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3926)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 142

**Price** 14,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This large bass drum is made of driftwood and whale hide, with swirling shapes that hint at more distinct and sinister forms carved on its surface. This drum grants you a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument. You can communicate basic ideas with whales and other large sea animals by playing music with this instrument.

**Activate—Call from the Depths** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** You drum a song of an ancient creature, calling forth the cries of a great whale in the minds of your foes. All enemies in a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) take 9d10 sonic damage (DC 36 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Will save). Creatures who fail are also [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 17 Benthic Drums Uncommon Magical Source Battlecry! pg. 142 Price 14,000 gp Usage held in 2 hands Bulk 1 This large bass drum is made of driftwood and whale hide, with swirling shapes that hint at more distinct and sinister forms carved on its surface. This drum grants you a +2 item bonus to Performance checks while playing music with the instrument. You can communicate basic ideas with whales and other large sea animals by playing music with this instrument. Activate—Call from the Depths Three Actions (concentrate, emotion, fear, manipulate, mental, sonic) Frequency once per week; Effect You drum a song of an ancient creature, calling forth the cries of a great whale in the minds of your foes. All enemies in a 60-foot emanation take 9d10 sonic damage (DC 36 basic Will save). Creatures who fail are also frightened 1.

>
[Bestial Mutagen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3315)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=589" />
<trait label="Mutagen" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=808" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=670" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 289

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Your features transform into something bestial and lumbering. 

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack with the agile trait and a jaws unarmed attack. Striking runes don't modify the damage caused by these attacks. 

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks, and [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks.

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 96 **Price** 140 gp **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** L **Activate**Interact, Strike --- When stared at, a _bewildering spellgun_ seems to warp the space around it, creating a mind-bending sensation. Whispers of gibberish arise from it, making their way to nearby ears despite any other sounds in the area. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target’s AC. This spellgun has a range increment of 15 feet. Once fired, the spellgun twists in your hand and melts away. **Critical Success** The target is [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63) for 1 minute.
**Success** The target is confused for 1 minute but can attempt a DC 25 Will save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

<title

    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Blakenshipper](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3927)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 142

**Price** 340 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This strange instrument is both played and worn, consisting of a set of pipes on a metal arm attached to a harness, a horn, a drum attached to a foot pedal, arm bellows, various keys, cymbals, and more esoteric elements. The blakenshipper grants you a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument.

**Activate—Be the Band** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You work double-time, playing an entire band’s composition yourself, bolstering those around you by your mighty effort. You and all allies within a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) gain 15 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) that last for 1 round. For the next minute, you can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) to continue the music, granting you and all allies within a 60-foot emanation 5 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round; this Sustain action gains the auditory and manipulate traits.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Bloodhound Mask](/Equipment.aspx?ID=694)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Advanced Player's Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=39) pg. 254

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This wide, single-use mask is designed to be slipped over your mouth and nose and its alchemical filter activated all with one hand. Once activated, the mask sharpens odors, giving you [imprecise scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) with the listed range. You can't wear other masks while you're wearing a bloodhound mask. When you use [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if you're untrained, and the mask grants you the listed item bonus to your Survival check. The GM sets the Survival DC based on the area's ability to hold scent rather than on visual clues, as normal for using scent.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 5+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Boots of Free Running](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2456)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Firebrands](/Sources.aspx?ID=196) pg. 84

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access** Second-mark members of the Firebrands have access to this item.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These comfortable and practical boots slip on easily and fill you with boundless energy. The treads of these boots provide exceptional traction, with improved grip on surfaces you would traditionally have difficulty traversing. While wearing the boots, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=28) and to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) and [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The traction of your boots improves, allowing you to run along vertical surfaces for 1 minute. When you Stride, you can run up solid vertical surfaces, like walls, at your full Speed. You must start your movement on a horizontal surface. If you end a Stride off the ground, you must Stride along the surface again until you reach a horizontal surface or you begin to fall (though you can [Grab an Edge](/Actions.aspx?ID=95), if applicable). If you have means of walking on water, such as with [_water walk_](/Spells.aspx?ID=371) or similar abilities, you can also run along flimsy vertical surfaces, as well as vertical liquids such as a waterfall.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

These comfortable and practical boots slip on easily and fill you with boundless energy. The treads of these boots provide exceptional traction, with improved grip on surfaces you would traditionally have difficulty traversing. While wearing the boots, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=28) and to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) and [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37).

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Boots of the Blight](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3693)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Spore War</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #210: Whispers in the Dirt](/Sources.aspx?ID=253) pg. 78

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn shoes

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Tanglebriar is not the only realm plagued by fiendish fungi. The soldiers of Nirmathas have long fought against a similar blight deep in Fangwood, and these boots are one of the more potent tools they’ve developed to help in this pursuit. Now that the Fangwood blight has been mostly contained, many of these boots have been gifted to elven soldiers, for they are equally useful to those who operate within Tanglebriar’s borders. They are also regarded as great trophies for the [demons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=387) and cultists who dwell within Tanglebriar, for not only can they make use of these boots’ powers, but wearing something created by your enemy gives [Treerazer’s](/Deities.aspx?ID=324) agents yet another way to engage in psychological warfare—they often adorn their boots with severed elf ears, or worse! 

These leather boots remain covered in mud no matter how often they are cleaned. The oiled leather resists water and keeps the feet and legs dry even when wading through water, but the boots retain a damp, fungal smell reminiscent of rotting vegetation. While wearing the boots, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=2374) or [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381) and to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks to [Balance](/Actions.aspx?ID=2369).

**Activate—Swift Sidestep** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are about to make a Reflex saving throw against an [environmental hazard](/Rules.aspx?ID=2588) or [terrain feature](/Rules.aspx?ID=1791);  **Effect** The boots help you to avoid the hazard or effect, granting you a +2 status bonus to your saving throw. If you succeed at the saving throw, you become [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=89) for 1 minute, but can use the additional action only to [Stride](/Actions.aspx?ID=2305).

**Activate—Fungal Stride** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You ignore the effects of [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) and gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) 10 to damage caused by hazardous terrain. This activation lasts for 10 minutes.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Age of Ashes</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #147: Tomorrow Must Burn](/Sources.aspx?ID=8) pg. 71

**Price** 680 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This mid-sized, silver cauldron is a boon within areas where access to fresh food is limited, for it can be commanded to fill itself with hearty (and delicious) vegetable stew. <title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Bracers of Hammers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2526)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 69

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn bracers

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These brilliant golden bracers feature a hammer motif as part of their engravings. While wearing them, your body surges with strength and you gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) and [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=40). If you succeed, but not critically succeed, at your check to Disarm a creature, the effects of your check last until the start of your next turn, instead until the start of the target's turn. If you succeed at a check to Trip a creature, it takes 1d6 bludgeoning damage or 4d6 bludgeoning damage on a critical success. When you invest the bracers, you either increase your Strength score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You reach for a foe and attempt to topple them with a powerful flip. Attempt an Athletics check to Trip a creature within reach. On a success, the creature is knocked [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and takes 10d6 bludgeoning damage (double on a critical hit). If you knock the creature prone, it must also attempt a DC 35 Reflex save. On a failure, it drops any items it's holding.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

Etchings of powerful bears decorate these brass bracers. You gain a +3 item bonus to Athletics checks and a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to lift a heavy object, [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), and [Force Open](/Actions.aspx?ID=34). When you invest the bracers, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. 

**Activate—Bear Hug** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** Attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) a creature. If you succeed, you crush the creature in your grasp, dealing bludgeoning damage to it equal to your Strength modifier. If you critically succeeded, the damage is equal to double your Strength modifier and the creature [suffocates](/Rules.aspx?ID=2439) as long as it remains grabbed or restrained by you.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The _brazier of harmony_ is a circular, orb-shaped censer etched with celebrating creatures shaking hands and dancing. The brazier contains a pleasant-smelling potpourri of dried flowers and incenses, designed to create a calm atmosphere that encourages meditation, thoughtfulness, and camaraderie. While holding the lit censer, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks, whether the censer is activated or not.

**Activate—Light Incense** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))**Cost** incense worth at least 1 sp; **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** When the incense is lit, pleasant, floral smoke surrounds the censer in a 20-foot emanation, creating a space of peace and harmony. Each creature that breathes the smoke is affected by 3rd-rank [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=31) and is then temporarily immune for 24 hours. The spell's effects end when the incense burns out.

</column>

>
[Broken Tusk Pendant](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1508)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Quest for the Frozen Flame</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #175: Broken Tusk Moon](/Sources.aspx?ID=112) pg. 77

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The followers of the Broken Tusk have passed down their custom of crafting and gifting these small ivory necklaces for generations. They're typically made from mammoth tusk (though any type of ivory will do), and each is carved to resemble a particular kind of animal—usually a raven, a moose, an ox, or an otter. Because tradition dictates that Broken Tusk followers take ivory only from already-dead animals, _Broken Tusk pendants_ are especially rare; if an individual loses their pendant, it might be years before they acquire the materials necessary to fashion a replacement. _Broken Tusk pendants_ bear no magical powers if they are made for oneself; only gifted pendants have true magical properties.

 You wear a _Broken Tusk pendant_ like jewelry or tie it to your clothing. A _Broken Tusk pendant_ grants you a +1 item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks; this bonus increases to +2 when you [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=58) of the specific kind depicted by the pendant.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** An [animal](/Traits.aspx?ID=9) targets you with a melee attack, and you can see the animal;  **Effect** You gain a +1 item bonus to AC against the triggering attack, or a +2 item bonus if the animal is the specific kind depicted by the pendant.

Once per day, when you use the _Broken Tusk pendant's_ activation, if the animal misses you, the _Broken Tusk pendant_ casts [_dominate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=87) on the animal (DC 30). You can choose whether to use this once-per-day effect after the animal misses you.

A _bullhook_ is a stout rod about 4 feet long with a blunt hook on the end. Too dull to be useful as a weapon, a _bullhook_ is instead used to direct animals in training or in performing their tasks. A _bullhook_ grants you an item bonus to [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) checks to [Command an Animal](/Actions.aspx?ID=58) while you are holding it.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _command_ of the appropriate level.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 15"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Busine of Divine Reinforcement](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1566)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Good" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=83" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Knights of Lastwall](/Sources.aspx?ID=123) pg. 89

**Price** 6,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

**Access** Knights of Lastwall have access to this item.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This long, straight, trumpet-like instrument is made of well-polished brass and adorned with imagery of angels fighting demons or religious symbols. When played as an instrument, the busine generates powerful and harmonious notes and grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=16)) **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** You play a few notes on the busine. Evil creatures within 60 feet who hear the notes must succeed at a DC 34 Will save or be [stunned](/Conditions.aspx?ID=36) for 1 round, or 2 rounds on a critical failure; this is an [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93) effect.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You blow into the busine and conjure a [celestial](/Languages.aspx?ID=16) with the effects of a 6th-level [_summon celestial_](/Spells.aspx?ID=317) spell, but there are no alignment restrictions to define which celestials you can call. The celestial will fight only evil creatures and leaves after all present evil creatures have been defeated or the spell's duration ends, whichever comes first. You can Sustain the Activation to extend the spell's duration, as normal. If you have a deity and the conjured celestial's alignment is one of your deity's preferred alignments, the effect functions as a normal 6th-level _summon celestial_ spell instead, meaning the celestial will fight any creature, not just evil creatures, and will perform other tasks as you command.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 3+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Camouflage Suit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1201)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 178

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This lightweight mesh fits easily over light armor. The suit is designed to incorporate local flora and ground clutter into the mesh to help you blend in seamlessly with the environment. Due to the abrasive nature of the materials used, this item is unsuitable for use by unarmored characters. You can prepare the suit for use within your current environment by using an exploration activity that takes at least 10 minutes, but sometimes longer if the materials are hard to find or the environment is unusual enough to warrant additional difficulty in preparing camouflage that can blend with it consistently.

 A suit prepared in this manner grants you a +1 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks while you attempt to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=62) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=63) in the specific environment it has been prepared for. >
[Camouflaging Chromatophores](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3180)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Graft" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=790" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 97

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** implanted

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Special cells in your skin can change color to help you blend in with your environment. You gain the listed item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) and [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404).

**Activate—Background Adaptation** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** For 1 minute, you can [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) without needing [cover](/Rules.aspx?ID=2372) or [concealment](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) to do so. This doesn’t allow you to [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) without ending your movement in cover or concealment, however, as your skin’s attempts to match the background as you move produce noticeable rippling waves of color.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Camouflaging Chromatophores (Lesser)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

fields.item_bonus_note: Demoralize a specific creature
fields.markdown:
May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts **Source** [Pathfinder #196: The Summer That Never Was](/Sources.aspx?ID=214) pg. 81 **Price** 100 gp **Usage** worn cloak **Bulk** L --- While [Yaezhing](/Deities.aspx?ID=184) is feared and seldom worshipped in the open, some regions of Tian Xia see him as a god of necessary evil and their only hope for justice. This garment is often worn by bounty hunters or priests of Yaezhing, yet non-worshippers of the god of harsh justice sometimes wear this item without fear of religious persecution. The red cape appears almost black while in the shadows, with a lighter red mandala pattern on it that resembles a shuriken. When you invest a _cape of justice_, you must designate a single creature as your offender. You must have met the creature before, or the creature should have a persona well known to the public (for instance, a bandit's epithet, if not their face as shown on a wanted poster). You gain a +1 item bonus to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53) this creature. If you don't designate a creature as your offender when you invest the _cape of justice_, or if 24 hours pass without you either slaying or capturing your offender, your thoughts become worried and distracted and you take a –1 item penalty to Perception checks for the next 24 hours. **Activate** command, Interact ([force](/Traits.aspx?ID=75)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** By using a free hand to grab the edge of your cape and give it a quick flourish, you cause a red, shuriken-shaped bolt of force to fire at a target within 60 feet that you can see. The shuriken hits automatically and deals 1d4+1 force damage, or 2d4+2 force damage if the target is your designated offender. If the target is within 30 feet, you can attempt to Demoralize the target as a free action after the shuriken strikes them. **Activate** command, Interact ([incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** You produce [manacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=32) from the cape and then fling them at a Medium or Small bipedal target within 30 feet. The target must attempt a DC 18 Reflex save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected, and the manacles vanish.
**Success** The manacles strike the target's legs but fail to latch properly. The target is [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) until the start of your next turn, at which point the manacles vanish.
**Failure** The manacles lock on the target's legs, causing the target to take a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute, or until it [Escapes](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) or is freed by someone using [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70) (DC 18), after which the manacles vanish.
**Critical Failure** As failure, but the target is [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24) for as long as the manacles remain in place.

[Cape of the Open Sky](/Equipment.aspx?ID=948)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Fists of the Ruby Phoenix</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight!](/Sources.aspx?ID=86) pg. 74

**Price** 22,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This cloth of gold cape was originally gifted to one of Goka's emperors centuries ago. Since then, it has spawned many imitations, which are all alike in that they are dyed with an elaborate seal depicting two drakes flanking Goka's palace and the Seven Dragons Bridge. The beautiful cape grants you a +3 item bonus to checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) and to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50). While you wear the cape, the weather (including wind and fog) doesn't affect your movement or vision. Additionally, whenever you fall while wearing the _cape of the open sky_, the cape automatically casts [_feather fall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=111) on you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;     **Effect** The cape becomes a pair of golden drake wings that grant you a fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** The cloak pushes you onward. You Stride or [Fly](/Actions.aspx?ID=94) up to your Speed, but you can move only in a straight line. You gain a +15-foot status bonus to your Speed and fly Speed for this movement.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

    level="1"
    right="Item 11+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Carver-Cutter](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2640)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 201

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Battle Axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Many of the experienced woodcarvers of the [Plane of Wood](/Planes.aspx?ID=25) learn to fight as well, the better to travel into hazardous areas in search of rare and beautiful types of wood for their craft. A _carver-cutter_ serves a dual role as a weapon and a tool for felling trees and engraving wood. The _+2 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [battle axe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=16)_ looks like an exquisitely made woodcutting axe.

**Activate—Carving Chisel** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You pull free a woodworking chisel stored in the knob of the axe. It can have any standard chisel shape you imagine as you activate this ability. Each _cassock of devotion_ depicts scenes related to the domains of a certain deity. It serves as a religious symbol of that deity, and it doesn’t need to be wielded to provide that benefit. You gain a +2 item bonus to Religion checks and a +1 item bonus to the divine skill of the deity to whom the cassock is dedicated.

**Craft Requirements** You are a cleric who worships the deity tied to the cassock.

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 105 **Price** 2,600 gp **Usage** held in 2 hands **Bulk** 2 --- The main portion of this set of bagpipes is fashioned from the dried skin of a [cauthooj](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2870), with the feathers still attached. The bird’s vocal cords are crafted into the instrument’s reeds. The pipes grant a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with them. **Activate—Disorienting Fugue** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=631), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Effect** You play several notes on the pipes, quickly altering their pitch and tone. Each creature within a 20-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must attempt a DC 31 Will save to resist the song. Creatures that attempt this save become temporarily immune to Disorienting Fugue for 1 minute. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected and its temporary immunity to Disorienting Fugue increases to 1 hour.
**Success** The target is unaffected.
**Failure** The target is [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63) for 1 round.
**Critical Failure** The target is confused for 1 round and immediately attacks itself (in the normal fashion for attacking oneself while confused). This [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) doesn’t give the creature a flat check to recover from the confusion. **Activate—Throw Song** ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Trigger** A creature within 30 feet attempts a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) against you or an ally; **Effect** You let loose a staccato chirp from the pipes that appears to come from somewhere else. The triggering creature must attempt a DC 31 Will save. On a failure, the creature redirects the Strike to another creature of your choice within reach of the melee Strike. If no other creatures are within range, the affected creature instead takes a –2 penalty to the Strike. **Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include the skin and vocal cords of a [cauthooj](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2870).

---

This suit of _+2 resilient [chain mail](/Armor.aspx?ID=9)_ is made of fine white links of a strange and slightly translucent pale metal, and the sleeves and skirt are fashioned into smaller trails that resemble feathers. Unlike normal chain mail, celestial armor has no Speed reduction, its armor check penalty is 0, and its Bulk is 1. 

 You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and saving throws against fiends. You appear radiant while you wear the armor, giving you a +2 item bonus to Diplomacy checks against all creatures except fiends.

 If you are not good, you are drained 2 while wearing _celestial armor_. You can’t recover from this condition while wearing the armor.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor sprouts glowing wings that grant you a fly Speed of 30 feet. The wings shed bright light in a 40-foot radius (and dim light to the next 40 feet). The wings fade away after 10 minutes.

**Craft Requirements** You are good.

---

This wheelchair is outfitted with a variety of tools and devices to assist with the creation and production of a number of mechanical implements. While seated in a chair of inventions, you have a worn [superb repair kit](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2747) that doesn’t count against your Bulk limit or maximum worn items.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The chair deploys a complete e[xpanded alchemist’s lab](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2701). The chair is immobile while this lab is deployed, but levers and gears in the chair allow you to easily retrieve and access everything you need from both the attached superb repair kit and the deployed lab to [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=2385). This setup is highly efficient and gives you a +2 circumstance bonus to [Earn Income](/Actions.aspx?ID=2364) using [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=37).

>
[Choral Toga](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3645)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 81

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn clothing

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant toga is infused with inexhaustible energy to enjoy life possessed by [azatas](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=368). You gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) to [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) 20 and become immune to [deafened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=66). When you [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) in the robes, you either increase your Constitution score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you become deafened while wearing the toga. 

**Activate—Elysium's Grasp** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You are exposed to an [inhaled](/Traits.aspx?ID=634) [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669);  **Effect** Purifying gusts of sweet-scented air swirl around you, making you immune to inhaled poisons for 1 minute.

**Activate—Elysium's Breath** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623))    **Effect** The air around the robe constantly circulates to keep you healthy. For 8 hours, you become immune to [diseases](/Rules.aspx?ID=2767) spread via inhalation, [olfactory](/Traits.aspx?ID=664) effects, and environmental effects that would prevent you from breathing (including being underwater or from being strangled).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Pathfinder #208: Hoof, Cinder, and Storm](/Sources.aspx?ID=250) pg. 80

<row gap="medium">

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

---

This thick, waxy gel erases the effects of flame. It restores 2d12 Hit Points to a creature when applied to their body. If the creature has taken [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=604) damage within the last minute, it restores additional Hit Points equal to the amount of fire damage the creature took within the last minute (maximum +10). Finally, the creature becomes [immune](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) to the effects of [severe heat](/Rules.aspx?ID=2820) for 1 hour.

>
[Cinnamon Seers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1910)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Lozenge" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=484" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 47

**Price** 14 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Zippy, alchemically treated cinnamon suffuses cinnamon seers, a rock candy with a lively taste that provides a mental boost. A cinnamon seer remains in your mouth for 1 hour, its stimulating flavor granting you a +1 item bonus to checks to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26).

 **Secondary Effect** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76)) **Trigger** You gain no information from a Recall Knowledge check; **Effect** Reroll the triggering check. If this was a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) check, the GM rerolls rather than you; the candy doesn't give you any insight into what the GM rolled, so in that case, you're rerolling based only on guesswork. The seer becomes inert. You become temporarily immune to cinnamon seers until the next time you make your daily preparations.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.text: Item 4 Cinnamon Seers Alchemical Consumable Lozenge Source Treasure Vault pg. 47 Price 14 gp Usage held in 1 hand Zippy, alchemically treated cinnamon suffuses cinnamon seers, a rock candy with a lively taste that provides a mental boost. A cinnamon seer remains in your mouth for 1 hour, its stimulating flavor granting you a +1 item bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge. Secondary Effect Reaction (fortune) Trigger You gain no information from a Recall Knowledge check; Effect Reroll the triggering check. If this was a secret check, the GM rerolls rather than you; the candy doesn’t give you any insight into what the GM rolled, so in that case, you’re rerolling based only on guesswork. The seer becomes inert. You become temporarily immune to cinnamon seers until the next time you make your daily preparations.

    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Circlet of Persuasion](/Equipment.aspx?ID=400)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 603

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn circlet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elegant silver band often resembles curling fig leaves and fits around your brow. You gain a +2 item bonus to Deception and Diplomacy checks. When you invest the circlet, you either increase your Charisma score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 4th-level [_charm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=34) spell (DC 38).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 6+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Clandestine Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3067)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 287

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

When you pull up the hood of this nondescript gray cloak (an Interact action), you become drab and uninteresting, gaining a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks and to Deception checks to Impersonate a forgettable background character, such as a servant, but also taking a –1 item penalty to Diplomacy and Intimidation checks. 

**Activate—Cloak Identity** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pull the cloak's hood up and gain the benefits of [_veil of privacy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739) for 1 hour or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Clandestine Cloak
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 287, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 608

**Price** 230 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Standard"
>
Clandestine Cloak (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 287, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 608

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The item bonus is +2, and when you activate the cloak, you gain the benefits of 5th-rank [_veil of privacy_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1739) for 8 hours.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 8+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Clarity Goggles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2314)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 146

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The counteract check from a pair of clarity goggles has a counteract rank of half the item’s level rounded up._

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Clarity goggles_ feature faceted lenses that filter your surroundings from several slightly different angles at once, giving you a sharper picture of them. While wearing the goggles, you gain a +1 item bonus to visual Perception checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You focus on your environment and the creatures around you to see them as they really are. The GM rolls a [secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check using your Perception bonus against any [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=92) effect created by a 3rd-rank or lower spell or a creature of 8th level or lower. You must be able to see the illusion, and it must be within 60 feet. If the check succeeds, you see through the illusion for 10 minutes.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Price** 2,450 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The goggles grant a +2 item bonus. They work against effects created by 6th-rank or lower spells or a creature of 13th level or lower.

</traits>
