<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cloak of Elvenkind](/Equipment.aspx?ID=424)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 608

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This cloak is deep green with a voluminous hood, embroidered with gold trim and symbols significant in elven culture. The cloak allows you to cast the _[ghost sound](/Spells.aspx?ID=132)_ cantrip as an arcane innate spell. When you adjust the cloak’s clasp (an Interact action), the cloak transforms to match the environment around you and muffles your sounds, granting you a +1 item bonus to Stealth checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw the hood up and gain the effects of [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164), with the spell's normal duration or until you pull the hood back down, whichever comes first. If you're also wearing _[boots of elvenkind](/Equipment.aspx?ID=413)_, you can activate this ability twice per day.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>
Cloak of Elvenkind
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 608

**Price** 360 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 12"
pfs="Standard"
>
Cloak of Elvenkind (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 608

**Price** 1,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

The cloak grants a +2 item bonus, and the effects of 4th-level _invisibility_. If you’re also wearing _boots of elvenkind_, the _greater cloak of elvenkind_ allows you to Sneak in forest environments even when creatures are currently observing you.

**Access** You're from Hermea

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

These cloaks are created from hand-dyed leather decorated with gemstones, appealing to the individual tastes of the owner. The beautiful decorations of these cloaks encourage their owner to wear them no matter the season, making it visibly part of their unique style. Wearing the cloak boosts self-confidence, granting a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks. 

**Activate—Overcome Self-Doubt** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You readjust your cloak, straightening the collar and brushing out any wrinkles. You gain the effects of a _[heroism](/Spells.aspx?ID=1555)_ spell for 1 minute.

<title

    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cloak of Swiftness](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3009)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=532" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 270

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This thin cloak is surprisingly light, as if clouds or the very wind were woven together to make the garment. The cloak grants you a +3 item bonus to Acrobatics checks. When you invest the cloak, you either increase your Dexterity modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate—Ride the Wind** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You tug on the cloak, wrapping yourself in the power of wind. You gain a fly Speed of 30 feet for 1 hour. While wrapped in the cloak, you become translucent, causing you to become [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) for the duration.

Sewn from several long strips of luxurious brown and black silk, this cloak grants you a +2 item bonus to Stealth checks as well as to Acrobatics checks to Maneuver in Flight. You can also use your feet to hang from any surface that can support your weight, without requiring any check, though you still must attempt Athletics checks to Climb in order to move around while inverted.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You can either transform the cloak into bat-like wings that grant you a fly Speed of 30 feet for 10 minutes, or have the cloak turn you into a bat by casting a 4th-level [_pest form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=217) spell on you.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 18"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Clockwork Cloak](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2310)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Clockwork" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=331" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 146, [Pathfinder #161: Belly of the Black Whale](/Sources.aspx?ID=51) pg. 79

**Price** 20,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Paper-thin interlocking cogs and gears make up the bronze _clockwork cloak_.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** You're struck by a melee attack with a held weapon;  **Effect** The folds of the cloak attempt to divert the attack and catch the weapon in the cloak's gears. Make an [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) check to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) the attacking creature.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You wrap the cloak around yourself and the winding gears decelerate your body, causing you to enter standby mode. While in standby mode you don't need to eat, drink, or sleep. You remain aware of your surroundings but take a –4 penalty to Perception checks. You can stay in standby mode indefinitely, although your body ages normally. You can leave standby mode as a free action. If you do so to initiate combat, you gain a +2 item bonus to your initiative roll.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Cloister Robe](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2321)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The most devoted, [cloistered clerics](/Doctrines.aspx?ID=2) wear a _cloister robe_. Decorations symbolic of a specific deity adorn the robe, and the robe's colors and the complexity of its construction fit the deity's outlook. The robe serves as a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of that deity, and it doesn't need to be wielded to provide that benefit.

 The robe is _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [explorer's clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2)_ and grants a +1 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) checks. The robe doesn't grant any benefits to a wearer who doesn't worship the deity tied to the robe. In addition, when you cast a domain spell from one of the deity's domains, you gain resistance to damage from [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48) spells until the end of your next turn. This resistance is equal to half the robe's level.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [cleric](/Classes.aspx?ID=5) who worships the deity tied to the robe.

---

The most devoted, [cloistered clerics](/Doctrines.aspx?ID=2) wear a _cloister robe_. Decorations symbolic of a specific deity adorn the robe, and the robe's colors and the complexity of its construction fit the deity's outlook. The robe serves as a [religious symbol](/Equipment.aspx?ID=41) of that deity, and it doesn't need to be wielded to provide that benefit.

 The robe is _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [explorer's clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=2)_ and grants a +1 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) checks. The robe doesn't grant any benefits to a wearer who doesn't worship the deity tied to the robe. In addition, when you cast a domain spell from one of the deity's domains, you gain resistance to damage from [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48) spells until the end of your next turn. This resistance is equal to half the robe's level.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [cleric](/Classes.aspx?ID=5) who worships the deity tied to the robe.

>
[Cloud Buns](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3459)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Tian Xia Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=230) pg. 105

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access** Tian Xia Origin

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

White, pillowy dough surrounds an interior containing minced meats, spices, and herbs. The dough is steamed with elemental magic to make it light and airy while keeping the meaty center moist. When you consume a bun, a set of small clouds form around your feet that grant you a [_fly_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1534) Speed of 30 feet or your speed, whichever is lower, for 1 round.

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=589" />
<trait label="Mutagen" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=808" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=670" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 289

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Your mind becomes clear, but physical matters seem ephemeral. 

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) checks become failures instead. 

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks, and [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming [encumbered](/Conditions.aspx?ID=70), and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

<title

    right="Item 1+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cognitive Mutagen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3316)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Elixir" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=589" />
<trait label="Mutagen" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=808" />
<trait label="Polymorph" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=670" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 289

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Your mind becomes clear, but physical matters seem ephemeral. 

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to Arcana, Crafting, Lore, Occultism, and Society checks and all checks to Recall Knowledge. Your critical failures on [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) checks become failures instead. 

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to weapon and unarmed attack rolls, [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks, and [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks. You can carry 2 less Bulk than normal before becoming [encumbered](/Conditions.aspx?ID=70), and the maximum Bulk you can carry is reduced by 4.

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 131 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- A _composer staff_ is short and shaped like an elegant black conductor's baton with a silver tip. When waved through the air, it hums melodically. In this way, you can play it as though it were an instrument, and it grants a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks made with it. **Activate** Cast a Spell; **Effect** You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list. **Craft Requirements** Supply one casting of all listed levels of all listed spells. Composer Staff **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 131 **Price** 80 gp **Bulk** 1 ---
  • **Cantrip** [_haunting hymn_](/Spells.aspx?ID=924), [_summon instrument_](/Spells.aspx?ID=721)
  • **1st** [_concordant choir_](/Spells.aspx?ID=886)
Composer Staff (Greater) **Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 131 **Price** 480 gp **Bulk** 1 ---

You need thieves' tools to [Pick Locks](/Actions.aspx?ID=70) or [Disable Devices](/Actions.aspx?ID=69) (of some types) using the [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) skill. If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with replacement picks appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the [Repair](/Actions.aspx?ID=42) action. If you wear your thieves' tools, you can draw and replace them as part of the action that uses them. 

You can use a set of tools with 1 hand if you're [wearing them](/Rules.aspx?ID=1456) or 2 if you're holding them.

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 176

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

---

Magical writing covers the surface of this beautiful conch shell, which emits a blue light from inside. A _conch of otherworldly seas_ is a [virtuoso handheld musical instrument](/Equipment.aspx?ID=37) that grants a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks attempted while using it. 

The conch is a planar key for [_interplanar teleport_](/Spells.aspx?ID=222) and similar magic to travel to the [Plane of Water](/Planes.aspx?ID=7). When using it this way, you can attune it to the waters of your destination to make it more likely to arrive where you intend to be, appearing 1d6×25 miles from your intended destination instead of 1d10×25 miles away.

**Activate—Voice of Oceans** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You hold the horn to your ear and can understand and speak [Thalassic](/Languages.aspx?ID=113) as long as it remains there.

**Activate—Sounds of the Deep** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You hold the horn to your ear and touch the correct series of runes inscribed on its surface, causing the conch to cast a 5th-rank [_clairaudience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=39) spell for your benefit. Provided you choose a location that's underwater, you can extend the spell's range to 1 mile and hear with perfect clarity.

These wooden discs sometimes form spontaneously at the Wood Pile, a secret conrasu location suffused with extraplanar energy. A _conrasu coin_ can be activated to call upon the power of a specific type of aeon.

**Price** 7 gp

<row gap="medium">

---

**Trigger** You attempt a Diplomacy check to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=2392).

 This coin has small wings like an arbiter, the messenger and diplomat aeon. When you activate the coin, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus on the Diplomacy check, which increases to a +3 circumstance bonus to Make an  Impression on a creature with the [aeon](/Traits.aspx?ID=525) trait.

**Trigger** You're targeted with an attack but the opponent hasn't rolled yet.

 This cog-like coin bears an hourglass on one side and the four-armed silhouette of a bythos—aeons that steward over time—on the other. When activated, you catch a glimpse of your body moving on one of its potential timelines in response to danger and you follow those movements to dodge. You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the attack, and after resolving the attack, you can Stride up to 10 feet without triggering reactions. If you have the [Nimble Roll](/Feats.aspx?ID=4953) feat and the attack misses, you can Stride up to 20 feet instead.

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

These wire spectacles have been fitted with circular glass lenses. While wearing the spectacles, you gain a +1 item bonus to Decipher Writing. 

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are attempting to read something in a language you don't understand; **Effect** You flick a small toggle on the side of the spectacles, flipping the lenses over in the frames. You can understand the meaning of the language you are reading. This doesn't let you understand codes, riddles, or metaphors (subject to the GM's discretion). This effect lasts 1 hour.

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 4"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Coral Aspect](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4968)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [High Seas](/Sources.aspx?ID=351) pg. 78

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access** You're from the Mordant Spire

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Made of petrified wood, this mask evokes the form of a coral reef. When you wear it, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=2381), and any armor you’re wearing gains the [aquadynamic](/Traits.aspx?ID=792) trait. 

**Activate—Cohabitate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** For 1 minute, your body becomes a mobile coral reef, letting much smaller creatures pass through or shelter in it. Creatures at least one size category smaller than you can share your space. Allies that share your space gain a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC, and you gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to any damage caused by a creature sharing the same space as you.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 69

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

This short golden crown bears a number of gems, each placed in the center of an engraving of a star. While wearing the crown, you are overcome with a nurturing instinct and understand the best ways to help others. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) checks.

 When you invest the crown, you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day; **Trigger** A living creature within 60 feet would die;  **Effect** You reach out to the creature with a lifeline. The triggering creature receives the effects of [_breath of life_](/Spells.aspx?ID=29), except they recover 7d8 Hit Points.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;  **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** An ally within 60 feet fails a non-[secret](/Traits.aspx?ID=142) check;  **Effect** You call out to your ally and offer a reassurance. The triggering ally rerolls the failed check and takes the higher result. This is a [fortune](/Traits.aspx?ID=76) effect.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Restricted"
>
[Corruption Cassock](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2376)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=280" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Unholy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=521" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 190

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +20; [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=2406) vision 30 feet, [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=2407) hearing 30 feet

**Communication** [telepathy](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=79) ([Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=155), [Empyrean](/Languages.aspx?ID=115), four other languages)

**Skills** [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) +21, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +19, [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) +19

**Int** +2, **Wis** +5, **Cha** +4

**Will** +20 

</column>

---        

Devotees of benevolent faiths fear and loathe corruption cassocks, each of which is dedicated to an [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521) deity. When the garment chooses a target, such as when it senses a worshipper of a deity who isn’t unholy, it alters its form to match another deity’s iconography, appearing to be a devoted vestments for that deity. Once donned, the cassock tries to subtly sway its wearer to the worship of its deity. If the wearer begins to succumb, the _corruption cassock_ gradually reverts to its true appearance, replacing its false iconography as its wearer converts.

A _corruption cassock_ functions as a [_devoted vestments_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3077) for any wearer it chooses. Once you invest the cassock, it fuses to you. While you remain loyal to another deity, you believe the cassock grants you a +2 item bonus to [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=46) checks and a +1 item bonus to the divine skill of the deity to whom you believe the cassock is dedicated. It does neither. The GM secretly adjusts your checks with those skills, causing you to fail at religious tasks more often. If you have multiple equal or lower item bonuses to the affected skills, the cassock takes precedence, negating those bonuses. If you convert to following the cassock’s true unholy deity, however, these bonuses function normally for you.

If you attempt to Cast a Spell that has the [holy](/Traits.aspx?ID=517) trait, the cassock can force you to attempt a DC 28 Will save. On a failure, you’re [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94) 1 for one minute (stupefied 2 on a critical failure). A _corruption cassock_ uses this ability to convince you that your deity has forsaken you.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a  cleric domain spell for a domain belonging to the deity you believe the cassock is dedicated to. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of this turn, it's lost. However, when you use this activation, the _corruption cassock_ can instead cast a domain spell of the same rank from its deity. It does so only to confuse and dismay you, harming your faith.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

    pfs="Limited"
>
[Covenant Tea](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3140)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Potion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=130" />
<trait label="Tea" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=738" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 77

**Price** 10 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact or 10 minutes (concentrate, Interact)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This green tea is often steeped in a pot with a dried persimmon. Traditionally, all participants in a complex discussion start their conversation with a tea ceremony involving _covenant tea_, with each member of the group enjoying the covenant of the shared beverage. Some have been known to use trickery and sleight of hand to ensure only those whose goals align with the tea preparer are served _covenant tea_, while others in the group are served non-magical (but still delicious) green tea, thus subtly tipping the balance in discussion toward those the tea server favors. This practice has resulted in some regions referring to covenant tea as “trickery tea.” Regardless of what you prefer to call the tea, when you drink it, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and to your Perception DC for 10 minutes. 

---

 [Tea Ceremony](/Traits.aspx?ID=738) The duration increases to 1 hour.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Some have been known to use trickery and sleight of hand to ensure only those whose goals align with the tea preparer are served covenant tea , while others in the group are served non-magical (but still delicious) green tea, thus subtly tipping the balance in discussion toward those the tea server favors. This practice has resulted in some regions referring to covenant tea as “trickery tea.” Regardless of what you prefer to call the tea, when you drink it, you gain a +1 item bonus to Diplomacy checks and to your Perception DC for 10 minutes. Tea Ceremony The duration increases to 1 hour.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Cowl of Keys](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2528)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Stolen Fate</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #192: Worst of All Possible Worlds](/Sources.aspx?ID=203) pg. 70

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This simple, tattered cloak is a faded green and features small, stylized keys sewn throughout its length. While wearing the cloak, you fade into the shadows and gain a +3 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. When you invest the cloak, you either increase your Dexterity score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You brush your hand against the cloak and your fingers transform into picks, tension wrenches, skeleton keys, and any other tools, providing you with a full set of [thieves' tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=58). This transformation doesn't otherwise hamper the normal use of your fingers or hands. These tools never break when you critically fail your check to [Pick a Lock](/Actions.aspx?ID=70). You can Activate the cloak again to revert your fingers to normal.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You place your hand against a wall, floor, or ceiling. You create a magical doorway within the surface that a creature can move through, as if the door had always been there. The doorway can penetrate up to 10 feet of material; particularly thick material, such as heavy stone walls, can cause this effect to fail, expending its use for the day. You can use an Interact action on the door to remove it from the surface and return it to its previous shape.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
<trait label="Positive" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=128" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind](/Sources.aspx?ID=97) pg. 75, [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 151

**Price** 250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn crown

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Stories tell of a forgotten king who once loved his subjects so much he was willing to give his own life energy for them. Whether true or not, this majestic wooden crown bears elaborate carvings depicting that tale. It's ringed with images of the same kingly figure giving more and more of himself to a throng of needy subjects. While wearing it, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You bow to an ally within 30 feet, creating a magical bond between the two of you. You cast [_shield other_](/Spells.aspx?ID=281) targeting the ally. The link remains even if you move more than 30 feet away from them. At the end of the spell's duration, your ally recovers 4d8 Hit Points and you recover half of what they recover.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Crown of the Kobold King](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1727)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Crown of the Kobold King</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Crown of the Kobold King](/Sources.aspx?ID=148) pg. 114

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Originally, this magical crown was to be known as the _Crown of Toil_—a magic item crafted by the dwarven priest named Gristogar. He intended for the crown to bolster his ability to rule and herald in a new era of a dwarven kingdom that followed the teachings of [Droskar](/Deities.aspx?ID=28). Yet Gristogar wasn't equal to his own ambitions, and before he could complete the _Crown of Toil_, his cult died out and he ended his own life. For centuries, the incomplete crown lay dormant, but over that time, fragments of Gristogar's soul infused it—not enough to transform it into a truly intelligent item, but enough to give it a rudimentary need and desire to be completed.

 When the Kobold King Merlokrep discovered the discarded crown and placed it upon his head, the crown at last had agency— if not in a hale and hearty dwarf, at least in the frame of a powerful and ambitious kobold. Just as the crown began influencing Merlokrep, so too did the Kobold King's personality influence the crown. Today, the device is known as the _Crown of the Kobold King_, and while it still urges the one who wears it to build a kingdom of endlessly toiling workers, it no longer does so in honor of Droskar. Instead, it seeks the rise of a brutal kobold kingdom.

 The crown appears as a golden band surrounded by iron spikes that glisten with fresh blood—the addition of a kobold skull to the top is largely decorative, but one the crown has grown to “enjoy.” Even in its incomplete state, a few rituals away from its true potential, the _Crown of the Kobold King_ is a potent item. Wearing the crown grants you a +2 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks and a +1 item bonus to saving throws against [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=68) effects.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The crown infuses you with the glorious conviction that you're meant to rule, granting you a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and Charisma-based skill checks for 1 minute.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (envision, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast a [_nightmare_](/Spells.aspx?ID=208) spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

When the Kobold King Merlokrep discovered the discarded crown and placed it upon his head, the crown at last had agency— if not in a hale and hearty dwarf, at least in the frame of a powerful and ambitious kobold. Just as the crown began influencing Merlokrep, so too did the Kobold King's personality influence the crown. Today, the device is known as the Crown of the Kobold King , and while it still urges the one who wears it to build a kingdom of endlessly toiling workers, it no longer does so in honor of Droskar. Instead, it seeks the rise of a brutal kobold kingdom. The crown appears as a golden band surrounded by iron spikes that glisten with fresh blood—the addition of a kobold skull to the top is largely decorative, but one the crown has grown to “enjoy.” Even in its incomplete state, a few rituals away from its true potential, the Crown of the Kobold King is a potent item. Wearing the crown grants you a +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks and a +1 item bonus to saving throws against fear effects. Activate Two Actions command, envision; Frequency once per day; Effect The crown infuses you with the glorious conviction that you're meant to rule, granting you a +1 status bonus to attack rolls, saving throws, and Charisma-based skill checks for 1 minute. Activate 10 minutes (envision, Interact); Frequency once per day; Effect You cast a nightmare spell.

When you activate this alabaster pendant, attempt to [Administer First Aid](/Actions.aspx?ID=54) using Medicine with a +1 item bonus to the check. <traits>

---

This blue velvet cloak is cut from the remains of a curtain from a destroyed theater. When worn, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks while acting, orating, or singing, as the cloak makes minor motions to accentuate your performance.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You take a bow, spread your arms, and the cloak casts 4th-level [_darkness_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1480) centered on a corner of your space. This darkness doesn't impede your vision. While the darkness persists, it emits noise like the applauding of a moderately sized crowd.

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 288 **Usage** worn shoes **Bulk** L --- These brightly colored, soft-soled boots motivate you to perform risky stunts and grant you the agility to succeed. The boots grant you a +2 item bonus to Acrobatics checks and a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Tumble Through an enemy's space.
The boots can grip solid surfaces and help you avoid a fall, allowing you to use the Grab an Edge reaction even if your hands aren't free. _[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters with access to firearms gain access to accessories that can be used with those weapons._

---

These scopes, popular with snipers and other sneaky sharpshooters who ply their trade in the dead of night, incorporate clouded crystals with magical properties into their design. While relatively useless under normal lighting conditions, these crystals can help bring things into focus when used in dim light. The scope is then given an enchantment to enhance these properties for use in darkness. The scope grants you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks involving sight in areas of dim light visible through the scope (as well as in areas of darkness, if the scope has been activated).

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You gain [darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=415) until the beginning of your next turn, as long as you continue to look through the scope.

This highly addictive drug is produced from the crushed bones of [demons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=28). Demon dust strengthens the inhaler's body for acts requiring great physical stamina. While the drug is in effect, users typically experience some form of memory loss. Others claim to have experienced hallucinations, flashbacks, and confusion for a few hours after the drug wears off.

The save for addiction to demon dust is DC 24, and the addiction has the [virulent](/Traits.aspx?ID=162) trait.

 **Saving Throw** DC 20 Fortitude; **Maximum Duration** 8 hours; **Stage 1** +2 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks and treat up to 4 Bulk as being negligible in weight (1 minute); **Stage 2** +2 item bonus to Athletics checks, treat up to 4 Bulk as being negligible in weight, and [stupefied 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=37) (1 hour); **Stage 3** stupefied 1 (1 hour); **Stage 4** stupefied 2 (1 hour); **Stage 5** stupefied 2 and all memories made since you were first exposed to this dose of demon dust become hazy and vague (1 hour); **Stage 6** stupefied 2 and all memories made in the previous 24 hours become hazy and vague (1 hour)

    level="1"
    right="Item 4"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Deravon's Helm](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5217)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Dead God's Hand</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=723" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [The Dead God's Hand](/Sources.aspx?ID=370) pg. 143

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn headwear

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

_Deravon's helm_ is crafted with crown-like embellishments to give it an unmistakable air of authority. Crafted of gold with silver filigree incorporating images of swords, jewels, and most of all, the Eye of [Aroden](/Deities.aspx?ID=512) (from which the tines of the crown extend), _Deravon's helm_ is much lighter than would be expected. Downward swooping guards adorn the sides of the helm while leaving the face fully visible. It grants you a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks made to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395).

**Activate—Bow Before Aroden** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [linguistic](/Traits.aspx?ID=642), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You issue a command to a humanoid within 30 feet to bow down before [Aroden's](/Deities.aspx?ID=512) glory. The targeted creature must make a DC 18 Will save to resist being compelled to drop [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) as its first action on their next turn (on a critical failure, the target must spend all three actions on its next turn remaining prone). If the target is a [human](/Traits.aspx?ID=627), they take a –1 status penalty to the save.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This leather satchel contains empty vials, a pair of tweezers, a supply of small linen cloths, a set of brass calipers and a knotted string for measuring distances, several pieces of chalk, a pen, and a blank notebook for keeping notes. These vestments are made of panels showing various scenes from the legends of a particular deity. It serves as a religious symbol of that deity, and you gain a +2 item bonus to Religion checks. When you cast [_harm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=146) or [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148), healing granted to followers of that deity is increased by the rank of the spell. 

**Activate—Domain Devotion** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Gain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a cleric domain spell for a domain belonging to the deity the vestments are dedicated to. If you don't spend this point by the end of this turn, it is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a cleric who worships the deity tied to the vestments.

[Diadem of Intellect](/Equipment.aspx?ID=401)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 603

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn circlet

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

An elegant, colorful gem cut into a complex geometric pattern is slotted into a narrow metal band that fits around your brow. You gain a +3 item bonus to checks to Recall Knowledge, regardless of the skill. When you invest the diadem, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence score. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _diadem of intellect_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You gain the effects of [_hypercognition_](/Spells.aspx?ID=156).

---

A common sight at political gatherings, a diplomat's charcuterie has fine meats, cheeses, nuts, fruits, and other finger foods mixed with reagents to engender friendly feelings between those consuming them. Contents of the plate vary by chef and the intended palates, from the hearty sausages and hard cheese of charcuterie from the Lands of the Linnorm Kings to the hot-pepper cheese curds and smoked almonds of Thuvian platters. After Activating the charcuterie by eating it, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) and Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=85). These bonuses last 24 hours or until you make your next daily preparations, whichever comes first.

These black leather gloves fit snuggly, running up the length of your arm to your elbow. Each glove has an angular fin running along the outside edge of your arms, which forms a narrow triangle when your hands meet in a diving position. While wearing the gloves, you gain a +1 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39).

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;   **Trigger** You would take [damage from falling](/Rules.aspx?ID=402) into water;  **Effect** The gloves create a hydrodynamic barrier around you, dispersing the damage that would be done to you during a high dive. You take damage as if the fall were half the distance, to a minimum fall of 5 feet. You then Swim with the effects of a critical success for the check.

Diving suits are bulky, waterproofed leather outfits with copper helmets, worn by divers and underwater salvagers. The suit grants a +1 item bonus to [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39) checks made underwater, and the helmet features tubes for connecting [_bottled air_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=250). When connected to a diving suit, bottled air doesn't need to be held and can be used to breathe as a free action. If you wear armor over a diving suit, you become [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) until you remove the diving suit.

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 126

**Price** 475 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Halberd](/Weapons.aspx?ID=381)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

Functioning as a _[+1 striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [halberd](/Weapons.aspx?ID=381)_ when wielded as a weapon, a _doomsweeper_ is a heavy steel rake-like implement commonly used by frontline soldiers to scour the battlefield for unseen dangers. When you hold a _doomsweeper_ extended in front of you, you gain a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to notice any hidden hazards in a 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386), with the bonus increasing to +2 if you are performing the Scout or Search exploration action.

**Activate—Clear the Way** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You’re holding the _doomsweeper_ in 2 hands; **Effect** The _doomsweeper_ sweeps the ground clear of obstacles in a 30-foot [cone](/Rules.aspx?ID=2386). This automatically removes any mundane effects of 4th level or lower that would hinder ground movement through the area of effect, including [caltrops](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2708) and non-magical [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2366) features no deeper or higher than 4 feet. It also attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) any magical dangers or obstacles with a +14 modifier and a counteract rank of 4th. Finally, it attempts a [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=50) check with a +14 modifier to disable all non-magical hazards (but not haunts) in the area. You don’t need to be aware of any hazards or effects in the area for the _doomsweeper_ to remove them, but you don’t become aware of them if the attempt fails.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Curtain Call</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Holy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=517" />

<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #206: Bring the House Down](/Sources.aspx?ID=247) pg. 81

**Price** 40,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn mask

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This [dragon](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=395)-themed half-mask helps you to navigate through darkness and to notice things from afar—such as helping to find seats in a theater after a show begins, or to pick up details from a show even if you’re seated in the back row! You gain a +3 item bonus to [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2298) checks and never take a penalty to Perception checks based on distance or weather. You gain [darkvision, or greater darkvision](/Rules.aspx?ID=2410) if you have darkvision. When you [invest](/Actions.aspx?ID=2799) in the mask you either increase your Wisdom score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score. If you are [unholy](/Traits.aspx?ID=521), you become [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=59) as long as you wear the mask.

**Activate—Dragons See the Truth** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You fail a saving throw against an [illusion](/Traits.aspx?ID=629) effect;  **Effect** The mask attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the triggering illusion with a counteract rank of 9 and a counteract modifier of +31. You then gain the effects of [_truesight_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1727) for 1 minute.

---

This scepter is made from dragon bone, with minute runes carved along its length, a dragonskin leather grip, and caps of gold on each end. The scepter grants you a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks to [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=2395). Such items are considered particularly gruesome and vile by dragons, and they’re invariably hostile to any creature they discover carrying a _draconic verge_, going so far as to single out that individual for destruction.

**Activate—Dragon’s Eminence** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You hold the verge aloft, tapping into the majesty of the dragon from whom the verge was made. All enemies in a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) must succeed a DC 23 Will save or become [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 2 (frightened 3 on a critical failure).

These silken handwraps feature intricate embroidery of a serpentine red dragon adorned with golden thread. The handwraps function as _+3 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater flaming](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295) [handwraps of mighty blows](/Equipment.aspx?ID=441)_. You also gain a +4 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks made to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) or [Shove](/Actions.aspx?ID=38). When you invest the handwraps, you either increase your Strength modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You slap the bottom of your palms with hands splayed outward, casting a 7th-rank [_breathe fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1457) spell (DC 41).

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour; **Trigger** You succeed or critically succeed with a Grapple;  **Effect** You gain a +2 status bonus to your Athletics DC against any checks made to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) your grapple until the end of your next turn.

---

When an irritant is caught within a dragon’s scales, the dragon’s body protects itself by coating the object in layers of dragon scale. Over time, it can form an item called a _dragon pearl_. Such pearls, hard and iridescent, are infused with draconic magic and can be powerful tools in the right hands. They’re usually placed in an ornate setting on a pin or necklace. Wearing the _dragon pearl_ grants you a +2 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks. 

**Activate—Pearlescent Shell** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call protective power from the pearl to form a defensive barrier around yourself. You’re affected by an 8th-rank [_containment_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1981) spell, which takes on the appearance of shimmering translucent dragon scales. The field has [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) 15 to one damage type related to the dragon the pearl came from. When you activate the pearl, you choose the type from all types the dragon has immunity or resistance to plus a type based on their tradition: [force](/Traits.aspx?ID=610) for [arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [spirit](/Traits.aspx?ID=737) for [divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) for [occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), or [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) for [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=676).

When an irritant is caught within a dragon’s scales, the dragon’s body protects itself by coating the object in layers of dragon scale. Over time, it can form an item called a _dragon pearl_. Such pearls, hard and iridescent, are infused with draconic magic and can be powerful tools in the right hands. They’re usually placed in an ornate setting on a pin or necklace. Wearing the _dragon pearl_ grants you a +2 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks. 

**Activate—Pearlescent Shell** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call protective power from the pearl to form a defensive barrier around yourself. The field has [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2312) 15 to one damage type related to the dragon the pearl came from. >
[Dragon Rune Bracelet](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1442)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Strength of Thousands</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #171: Hurricane's Howl](/Sources.aspx?ID=101) pg. 75, [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn bracelet

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This polished golden bracelet is formed around the scale of a famous dragon. The bracelet is etched with esoteric symbols or words—always in [Draconic](/Languages.aspx?ID=2)—that indicate kinship with dragons. As many types of _dragon rune bracelets_ exist as there are types of dragons, though dragon rune bracelets associated with [Uncommon](/Traits.aspx?ID=159) or [Rare](/Traits.aspx?ID=137) dragons are Rare.

 While wearing a dragon rune bracelet, you gain a +2 item bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks while interacting with dragons of the same type as the pendant's scale (such as [red dragons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=168) or [cloud dragons](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=176)). You also gain a +2 item bonus to saving throws against [_fear_](/Spells.aspx?ID=110) effects from any kind of [dragon](/Traits.aspx?ID=50).

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You can cast bloodline spells from the [draconic bloodline](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=5), such as from the [sorcerer](/Classes.aspx?ID=11) class or [sorcerer multiclass archetype](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=11); **Effect** You regain 1 Focus Point, which you can spend only to cast a sorcerer bloodline spell. If you don't spend this Focus Point by the end of your turn, it is lost.

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

---

While some unscrupulous chefs claim that this savory pudding is made with real dragon's blood, its crimson color and acrid smell actually come from bloody mandrake paste, ginger root, and distilled terrap sap. This potent combination singes the nostrils and throat, removing effects that make you sluggish. When you consume the pudding, it attempts a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check with the listed counteract modifier to remove the [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=35) condition from a single source, using the source of that condition to determine the counteract level and DC.

You can use the additional action to Step, Stride, Strike, or [Demoralize](/Actions.aspx?ID=53). If you choose to Demoralize, you gain a +2 item bonus to the [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) check.

[Dragonfire Halfbow](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3162)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=604" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 75

**Price** 1,800 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in one hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Composite Shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=75)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Crafted by layering bamboo with strips of sliced scales harvested from a fire-breathing dragon, this bow has a significant draw strength. This design is commonly seen in Hongal, as the shorter limbs allow for easier maneuvering on horseback. While the wielder of this _+2 striking [composite shortbow](/Weapons.aspx?ID=435)_ is mounted, they apply the bow's item bonus to Nature checks to Command your mount. 

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw the bow back to its maximum draw length without nocking an arrow, and as you release the string, the _dragonfire halfbow_ casts [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530) (heightened to 5th- level; DC 29 Reflex save), targeted at a point of your choosing within the spell's range. You and your mount are immune to the effects of this fireball.

</column>

</title>

<traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 77

**Price** 60 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to armor

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Free Action" /><row>([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))</row></row>

 

**Trigger** You take the [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81) action.

 
</row>

</column>

---

Tradition says the _dragonfly fulu_ should be affixed to the upper back, like the wings of an insect. When you Activate this fulu, you gain a +2 status bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks to [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) or [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37) for 1 minute. During this time, you can attempt an Athletics check to High Jump or Long Jump as a single action without the Stride requirement. You can also High Jump or Long Jump from a nonsolid substance, such as air or water, but if you use this power of the fulu, its effects ends after you jump.

Your eyes transform into those of a giant dragonfly, the thousands of separate facets wrapping around your head, and a pair of long, delicate, insectile wings grow from your upper back. You gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed. Additionally, you gain [low-light vision](/Rules.aspx?ID=416) and a +2 item bonus to visual Perception checks, and you can't be flanked except by creatures higher level than you are (though lower-level creatures can still help their higher-level allies flank). These effects last for 1 minute.

---

The faceplate of a dread helm has a fierce visage that magnifies the effects of fear. Concealed within is a reservoir that can hold a single [dread ampoule](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3292), which takes 3 Interact actions to install.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** A dread ampoule is installed in the helm; **Effect** The dread ampoule atomizes, creating a fear‑inducing mist that hangs around your face for 3 rounds. The mist grants an item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=40) checks equal to the dread ampoule’s item bonus. The mist also deals mental damage equal to the dread ampoule’s splash damage to all creatures within a 5-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) other than you. The activation uses up the dread ampoule, and the helm can’t be activated again until a new one is installed.

>
[Dream Hunter's Lodge](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5205)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Revenge of the Runelords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Dream" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=582" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
<trait label="Structure" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=704" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #220: Crypt of Runes](/Sources.aspx?ID=284) pg. 82

**Price** 13,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L  (when not activated)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This miniature hunter’s lodge fits comfortably into the palm of one’s hand. 

**Activate—Expand Lodge** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You set the lodge on the ground, where it expands into a structure 40 feet long, 20 feet wide, and 20 feet high. The lodge is well-built, with a sturdy stone foundation, thick timber walls, and a peaked roof shingled with scraps of bark. The lodge’s ground floor contains a dining hall on one end and a sitting area with a hearth surrounded by comfortable chairs on the other. A staircase connects the hall to the lodge’s second floor, which consists of four simply furnished bedrooms. The lodge is decorated throughout with taxidermic beasts native to the Dimension of Dreams. If a creature inside the lodge spends 10 minutes studying these trophies, they gain a +3 item bonus to the next skill check they make in the next 24 hours to Recall Knowledge about any creature with the dream trait. Furnishings or decorations removed from the lodge disappear but return to their original locations inside the lodge with the next activation. You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the dream hunter’s lodge to return it to its miniature form. 

**Activate—Oneiric Expedition** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The _dream hunter’s lodge_ has been expanded and you are inside; **Effect** Spend 1 Mythic Point. You and all creatures inside the lodge fall into a magical slumber, and the lodge disappears from existence. After 8 hours, the lodge reappears in the Dimension of Dreams (or in the Universe, if the lodge was already in the Dimension of Dreams), as if transported there by an _interplanar teleport_ spell. Upon arrival, creatures inside the lodge awaken, fully rested (but this effect does not increase the number of times per day you can do your daily preparations).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 151 **Price** 220 gp **Usage** worn headwear **Bulk** L --- Made of materials scavenged from wild places, a _druid's crown_ can be rebuilt for a variety of benefits. The crown grants you a +1 item bonus to a skill, and can be activated to cast a spell, both depending on the material used to build the crown, as listed on the table below. If you invest and wear [_living mantle_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3092) along with the crown, the crown's item bonus increases by 1 and its spell's DC rises to 27. You can invest this item only if you're a [druid](/Classes.aspx?ID=6). When you do, as a 10-minute activity that has the [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104) trait, you can disassemble and rebuild the crown with different materials, changing its item bonus and spell accordingly. ##
**Material****Item Bonus****Spell**
Antlers[Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7)[_Enlarge_](/Spells.aspx?ID=102)
Flowers[Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6)[_Animal allies_](/Spells.aspx?ID=863)
Leaves[Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15)[_One with Plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1618)
 **Activate** ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** The crown casts its spell at 2nd rank (DC 20). **Craft Requirements** You are a druid.

>
[Drum of Upheaval](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1281)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Grand Bazaar](/Sources.aspx?ID=100) pg. 30

**Price** 60,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This heavy drum is engraved along the sides with images of centaurs in fierce combat. The drum grants you a +3 item bonus on [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=12) checks you make using the drum. Additionally, it imparts the rhythms of two songs upon your mind as soon as you touch it. One is a fast marching cadence; the other is a frenetic ritual dance. Each song has a different activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** Dozens of spectral centaurs burst from the drum and stampede in a 60-foot cone. The stampede deals 7d10 force damage (DC 43 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The drum casts a DC 43 [_earthquake_](/Spells.aspx?ID=95) spell.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [centaur](/Monsters.aspx?ID=76).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

Long black feathers cover the leather pieces of this _[+1 resilient ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) [leather armor](/Armor.aspx?ID=41)_. The armor gives you the ability to glide safely to earth from high above the battlefield. It also grants you a +2 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks you attempt while in the air.

**Activate—Soar** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and 30 feet forward through the air. Provided you spend at least 1 action gliding on your turn and haven’t yet reached the ground, you remain in the air at the end of your turn. Otherwise, you fall.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 1"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Echo Token](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3521)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Convocation</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rival Academies](/Sources.aspx?ID=235) pg. 29

**Price** 3 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Visitors to the Echo Repository always emerge with one of these silver coins, stamped with the visage of a faceless queen, somewhere on their person. An _echo token_ carries a minute shard of the Echo Repository's mission to impart lost information. 

**Activate—Flip a Coin** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** When flipped, the coin disintegrates into a glittery mist. You learn and memorize one random fact about a specific type of [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=41) (such as Architecture Lore, Elf Lore, Astral Plane Lore) that you didn't previously know, chosen by the GM. The next time you attempt a check to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) on this type of Lore within the next year, you gain a +1 status bonus on the check. You can benefit from only one echo token at a time in this way; if you Flip another echo token, the Lore skill changes. However, the memorized fact will remain perfectly in your memory forever unless magically altered or removed.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

fields.markdown:
<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 11"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Eidolon Cape](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2323)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Focused" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=74" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 148

**Price** 1,400 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn cloak

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Though it appears to be one elegant piece, an _eidolon cape_ consists of a mantle for your shoulders and a detachable cape. The cape is designed to resemble your [eidolon](/Eidolons.aspx), either with a direct likeness or with features reminiscent of your eidolon. For instance, if your eidolon is a [dragon](/Traits.aspx?ID=50), the cape might depict a stylized dragon, or it might have a pattern of colorful scales with gold trim. An eidolon cape features the sigil you share with your eidolon prominently in its design. You gain a +2 item bonus to the skill that matches your eidolon's tradition: [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2) for [arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=11), [Religion](/Skills.aspx?ID=13) for [divine](/Traits.aspx?ID=48), [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) for [occult](/Traits.aspx?ID=120), or [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) for [primal](/Traits.aspx?ID=134).

 When you [Manifest your Eidolon](/Actions.aspx?ID=757), the cape transforms into the eidolon, and when the eidolon unmanifests, it turns back into the cape. If the cape is attached to the mantle, it comes free immediately, and the eidolon appears adjacent to you as normal. If not, the eidolon appears in a space adjacent to the cape. With the cape detached, the mantle is still light Bulk, and the whole cloak remains invested. If the cape is out of range (beyond 100 feet, typically) or there's not enough open space for the eidolon to manifest, your attempt to Manifest your Eidolon fails.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a summoner link spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a [summoner](/Classes.aspx?ID=18).

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

If the cape is out of range (beyond 100 feet, typically) or there’s not enough open space for the eidolon to manifest, your attempt to Manifest your Eidolon fails.

fields.text: Item 11 Eidolon Cape Conjuration Focused Invested Magical Source Treasure Vault pg. 148 Price 1,400 gp Usage worn cloak Bulk L Though it appears to be one elegant piece, an eidolon cape consists of a mantle for your shoulders and a detachable cape. The cape is designed to resemble your eidolon, either with a direct likeness or with features reminiscent of your eidolon. For instance, if your eidolon is a dragon, the cape might depict a stylized dragon, or it might have a pattern of colorful scales with gold trim. An eidolon cape features the sigil you share with your eidolon prominently in its design. You gain a +2 item bonus to the skill that matches your eidolon’s tradition: Arcana for arcane, Religion for divine, Occultism for occult, or Nature for primal. When you Manifest your Eidolon, the cape transforms into the eidolon, and when the eidolon unmanifests, it turns back into the cape. If the cape is attached to the mantle, it comes free immediately, and the eidolon appears adjacent to you as normal. If not, the eidolon appears in a space adjacent to the cape. With the cape detached, the mantle is still light Bulk, and the whole cloak remains invested. If the cape is out of range (beyond 100 feet, typically) or there’s not enough open space for the eidolon to manifest, your attempt to Manifest your Eidolon fails. ---

Used by soldiers who battle on the borderlands of Elysium, particularly in Gorum’s realm of Clashing Shore, these bronze spyglasses are somewhat plain-looking save for a single diamond set into the largest cylinder. An Elysian clairglass functions like a typical spyglass, but you can see twenty times farther while looking through it, rather than eight times farther. It also grants a +3 item bonus to Perception checks to notice details at a distance.

**Activate—Seek and Speak** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _Elysian clairglass_ casts [_clairaudience_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1465) and [_clairvoyance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1466) on the area you are currently observing with it. As long as you're holding the _Elysian clairglass_, you can speak through the floating eye or ear created by its spells, causing your voice to manifest as a whisper that only one person in range of the spells can hear, as a booming voice that everyone in range of the spells can hear, or as any combination in between those two extremes.

**Activate—Pinpoint** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast [_pinpoint_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1633).

Activate—Seek and Speak Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect The Elysian clairglass casts clairaudience and clairvoyance on the area you are currently observing with it. As long as you're holding the Elysian clairglass , you can speak through the floating eye or ear created by its spells, causing your voice to manifest as a whisper that only one person in range of the spells can hear, as a booming voice that everyone in range of the spells can hear, or as any combination in between those two extremes. Activate—Pinpoint Two Actions (concentrate, manipulate) Frequency once per day; Effect You cast pinpoint .

</title>

</traits>

**Bulk** L

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The pale liquid of _empath’s cordial_ changes color to reflect the mood of the creature nearest to it—turning blue for calm, red for anger, and green for envious, among other hues. For 1 hour after you drink this potion, you can sense the presence of general emotions, such as hostility toward you or the presence of an emotion effect impacting a creature’s emotions, within 30 feet. A creature that failed a saving throw against [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) can’t be detected. This potion doesn’t allow you to automatically tell what emotions a specific creature is experiencing, but you can attempt a [Perception](/Rules.aspx?ID=2040) check with a +2 item bonus (DC set by the GM) to discern that information. The potion also grants you a +1 item bonus to Perception checks to [Sense Motive](/Actions.aspx?ID=2302) against creatures whose emotions you can sense.

</column>

---

While most residents of—and travelers to—the Five Kings Mountains live underground, a significant number of people explore the regions’ awe-inspiring peaks. Among their many discoveries on Emperor’s Peak is a deposit of rainbow-colored rock crystal quartz with inherent magical properties that aid in survival, especially in the mountains. Dwarven artisans fashion chunks of this translucent quartz into fashionable bracelets. Wearing such a bracelet grants you a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406) and [Subsist](/Actions.aspx?ID=2368). This bonus increases to +3 when in mountainous [terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2365). If you attempt a Survival check to Subsist after 8 hours or less of exploration, you take only a –2 penalty instead of a –5 penalty.

>
[Emperor's Peak Quartz Bracelet](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3766)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Shining Kingdoms](/Sources.aspx?ID=265) pg. 100

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Characters from Five Kings Mountains have access to this option._

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While most residents of—and travelers to—the Five Kings Mountains live underground, a significant number of people explore the regions’ awe-inspiring peaks. Among their many discoveries on Emperor’s Peak is a deposit of rainbow-colored rock crystal quartz with inherent magical properties that aid in survival, especially in the mountains. Dwarven artisans fashion chunks of this translucent quartz into fashionable bracelets. Wearing such a bracelet grants you a +1 item bonus to [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=49) checks to [Sense Direction](/Actions.aspx?ID=2406) and [Subsist](/Actions.aspx?ID=2368). This bonus increases to +3 when in mountainous [terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=2365). If you attempt a Survival check to Subsist after 8 hours or less of exploration, you take only a –2 penalty instead of a –5 penalty.

---

When opened, this grimoire has unlimited pages that, oddly, seem almost eager to transcribe spells. Unlike most grimoires, it has no limits to its number of spells. The grimoire’s eagerness to contain your spells grants you a +1 item bonus to checks to [Learn a Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2366) if you do so by transcribing the spell into the grimoire. If you use the grimoire during your daily preparations and are capable of preparing spells of the appropriate rank, the grimoire’s nature leaks into your mind, allowing you to prepare an additional 1st-rank spell.

The grimoire's eagerness to contain your spells grants you a +1 item bonus to checks to Learn a Spell if you do so by transcribing the spell into the grimoire. If you use the grimoire during your daily preparations and are capable of preparing spells of the appropriate level, the grimoire's nature leaks into your mind, allowing you to prepare an additional 1st-level spell. Item 6 Endless Grimoire Source Secrets of Magic pg. 162 Price 230 gp Bulk L Item 10 Endless Grimoire (Greater) Source Secrets of Magic pg. 162 Price 900 gp Bulk L The item bonus is +2, and the additional spell is 3rd level. Item 14 Endless Grimoire (Major) Source Secrets of Magic pg. 162 Price 4,000 gp Bulk L The item bonus is +2, and the additional spell is 5th level. Item 18 Endless Grimoire (True) Source Secrets of Magic pg. 162 Price 23,000 gp Bulk L The item bonus is +3, and the additional spell is 7th level.

>
[Energizing Pill](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3152)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=528" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=564" />
<trait label="Lozenge" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=484" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #199: To Bloom Below the Web](/Sources.aspx?ID=225) pg. 73

**Price** 180 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This special blend of potent herbs comes in the form of a compact ball that allows it to be held in the mouth, where it remains for 1 hour. An energizing pill has a bitter taste at first, but the longer one lets it soak, the more complex and sweet its flavor grows. It heightens your reactions, granting you a +2 item bonus to initiative rolls with Perception.

 **Secondary Effect** <actions string="Reaction" /> **Trigger** You would become [clumsy](/Conditions.aspx?ID=61), [drained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=68), [enfeebled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=71), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), [sickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=91), [slowed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92), or [stupefied](/Conditions.aspx?ID=94); **Effect** Reduce the value of the condition you just gained by 1; if this reduces the value to 0, you don't gain the triggering condition.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Energizing Tea](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3141)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Season of Ghosts</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Potion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=130" />
<trait label="Tea" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=738" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #197: Let the Leaves Fall](/Sources.aspx?ID=222) pg. 77

**Price** 20 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact or 10 minutes (concentrate, Interact)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This sweet and refreshing tea is made by adding a mixture of honey, lemon slices, and sliced ginger. This is considered to be the bare minimum when serving _energizing tea_, and many go above and beyond by adding additional citrus fruits or berries to the mix or refusing to serve the tea at all without accompanying it with a full platter of spiced pastries and sweets. This golden tea has energizing properties and, when consumed, grants you a +1 item bonus to Athletics and Acrobatics checks for 10 minutes. 

---

 [Tea Ceremony](/Traits.aspx?ID=738) The duration increases to 1 hour. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
